conviction_note: Event confirmed (H1 results, 12:00 JST, inside the session); the print turns on whether SK Japan repeats last October's profit-and-dividend upward revision, and the evidence is mixed: demand is plainly running above a conservative plan (Q1 sales +23.5% against a +4.7% plan; prize-market peers still strong through August), but Q1 operating profit rose only 3.6% on FX and freight, the yen stayed near 157-160 through Jun-Aug against a 14.5%-margin Q2 comparative, and the stock has already rallied ~25% off its July low to record highs with a 22x margin long ratio. Findings sum -0.8; the scaled number is p_up 47 on a 7% abs move = -0.42. The two agree in sign and are both small because the lean is weak, not because the move will be small.
bar: No sell-side consensus (kabuyoho shows consensus '--'; 四季報 online unreachable to this session). Bar is the company's own FY2027/2 plan, unchanged since 2026-04-14: sales 17,000, OP 1,950, ordinary 1,960, NI 1,370 (¥m), dividend 12+12 yen post-split (Q1 短信, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260713592490.pdf). No H1 plan is published. print_vs_bar_pct is my estimate of H1 ordinary profit (Q1 473 + an estimated Q2 ~500-520) against half the FY ordinary plan (980). The bar that actually moves the stock is the company's own habit of revising up at Q2 (2022-10, 2023-10, 2025-10), which is unsourced as an expectation, so every finding is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% disclosed (no position >= 0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, via baseline). 信用倍率 22.19 (baseline, broker scrape): margin longs crowded, no squeeze fuel. findings.finding: Q1 (Mar-May 2026) showed the FX/freight squeeze the plan does not escape: sales +23.5% but OP only +3.6% (gross margin 28.5% -> 25.5%, 荷造運搬費 +47%), ordinary profit flattered by ¥44m of FX and derivative gains; USD/JPY averaged ~157-160 over Jun-Aug 2026 against ~147-149 a year earlier, so Q2 faces the same headwind against last year's exceptional 14.5% Q2 margin (OP 595). H1 OP is therefore likely ~48-52% of the 1,950 plan, against last year's H1 at 78% of its initial plan, which is what forced the +23% ordinary revision then; a profit revision of that size is not supported this time.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026-07-14, OP +3.6% with progress in line with the 5-year average and no revision: stock 822 -> 793 (-3.5%) and on to 731 within three sessions. Q2 2024-10-11, no Q2 revision: about -3.8% (baseline estimated history).
findings.why_not_priced: If the market had priced a no-revision or sales-only revision, the stock would not have rallied 25% off its July low to record highs into the print with margin longs at 22x the shorts; the price is behaving as if last October (profit +23%, dividend +7 yen, +15.7% reaction) repeats. The margin arithmetic needs the Q1 P&L lines and an FX comparison that no wire carries for a name with no analyst coverage.
findings.independence: FX series from a different source: https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/JPY=X?range=2y&interval=1mo (USD/JPY monthly closes 160.2 Jun, 160.1 Jul, 157.4 Aug 2026 vs 149.2, 147.0, 148.6 in 2025). Kabutan's Q1 summary (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7608&b=k202607140005) records the Q1 margin fall 11.8% -> 9.9%; same document underneath.

findings.finding: Demand is still running well above the plan's +4.7% sales growth: Q1 sales +23.5% (Character Entertainment +26.2%), and the prize-game market held through the Q2 months (GENDA's domestic amusement same-store sales 111% in August 2026; FuRyu's Apr-Jun crane-game prize business drove OP +52.8%). With a company that revised its plan at Q2 in 2022, 2023 and 2025 and set this year's plan at +4.8% OP, a sales upward revision at minimum is likely, and a profit and dividend raise (payout ~30%) is possible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-14 Q2 profit and dividend upward revision: カイ気配, about +15.7%. 2026-01-14 Q3 upward revision (+6% ordinary, +3 yen): turned negative on 出尽くし after a run-up. 2026-03-25 dividend raise: カイ気配. 2026-04-14 conservative +4% guide after a beat: about +10.7%.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the record-high run is the market expecting exactly this. What is not priced is the profit and dividend leg if margins held better than Q1, which would repeat last year's pattern; sized small for that reason.

findings.finding: The last upward revision that came after a run-up was sold: on 2026-01-14 SK Japan raised ordinary profit 6% and the dividend 3 yen and the stock turned negative on 材料出尽くし, kabutan citing the rise since mid-October; the setup now is a larger run (731 -> ~965, record highs) with margin longs at 22x the shorts and no short fuel.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-01-14: upward revision after a run-up, turned negative in the afternoon session. 2026-07-14: Q1 in line after a run from 735 to 850, -3.5% and lower the following days.
findings.why_not_priced: The baseline already carries -0.67 for margin overhang, so this is partly priced; what it adds is this name's own record of selling a modest revision after a run, which holders anchored on last October's +15.7% are not positioned for.

bar_hierarchy: Revision: likely on sales (Q1 +23.5% vs plan +4.7%), uncertain on profit (Q1 OP +3.6%, FX headwind, tough 14.5% Q2 margin comp); company revised at Q2 in 3 of the last 4 years. Returns: dividend follows a ~30% payout, so it rises only with a profit revision; no buyback history. New-year guide: n/a (H1). Quarter vs own 進捗率: Q1 ordinary 24.1% vs 5-year average 26.3% (last year Q1 30.4% of initial plan); H1 estimated ~50% of FY ordinary plan vs last year's 78% of initial plan.
baseline_tension: Agrees with the priced lean (-1.12, margin overhang plus run-up) and against the +8.9% run-up's implied optimism; the strongest positive the release could carry is a repeat of last October's profit plus dividend upward revision (+15.7% then), which I looked for and found demand evidence for but no margin evidence for, so the lean is small.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a progress rate anyone can compute from the last 短信 and public FX): p_up moved 45 -> 47; finding sizes left as drafted, since the core allows the lesson to move one number per measurement and the finding was already sized as an inference.
Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): wrote the strongest positive (repeat profit+dividend revision) into baseline_tension; I had looked for it, so p_up not moved further.
